text:
Anita: Ugh, ISP maintenance decided to happen right during my demo window. Wi‑Fi is totally dead. Anyone got a 10‑minute miracle? :sweat_smile:
Luca: Power‑cycle the router first (obvious but it works 40% of the time). Also try 2.4GHz if you usually use 5GHz — walls love 2.4.
Sasha: If you have your phone with a decent plan, tether it and set hotspot to 5GHz. Speed is meh but better than nothing.
Anita: Tried power cycle already. Router just blinks orange. Phone tethering patchy (old SIM). Also need to keep a stable connection for a screen share.
Marta: Do you have an Ethernet adapter? USB‑C -> Ethernet works wonders.
Anita: No adapter, but neighbour is home — might ask to share their Wi‑ but awkward.
Noah: If you're comfortable, ask — people are usually cool. Offer coffee or cookies as bribe :cookie:
Anita: Went to knock and they said yes! Lifesaver. Running a quick speedtest from their WiFi — looks... acceptable:
```
Ping: 24 ms
Download: 48.6 Mbps
Upload: 9.2 Mbps
```
Luca: Nice. That should be fine for demos unless you're streaming video. Use wired if possible.
Sasha: Also, drop your screen share to 720p or disable camera to be safe. Most people won't notice.
Anita: Switching to wired now (thank you, neighbour). Demo back on track. Sending cookies.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance: ISP-EdgeCorp maintenance window for Anita's postcode reported at 2026-03-23T20:00Z — expected intermittent connectivity for 2 hours.
Marta: :thumbsup: Glad it worked. Small WFH poll — who keeps an Ethernet adapter at home? Reply with :one: for yes, :two: for no, :three: sometimes.
Luca: :one:
Sasha: :two:
Noah: :three:
Anita: :two: but making an exception today.
Marta: Thanks folks — collecting for a small kit we can recommend in the WFH guide. Also kudos to neighbours and cookies :heart:
